name: Sale To POI Message Status Request V 08
definition: The SaleToPOIMessageStatusRequest message is sent by a sale system when the sale system wants to know the status of previous message that has not be answered.

Header.name: Header
Header.definition: Set of characteristics related to the transfer of the request.

StatusRequest.name: Status Request
StatusRequest.definition: Information related to a status request.

SecurityTrailer.name: Security Trailer
SecurityTrailer.definition: Trailer of the message containing a MAC or a digital signature.
